Helper function to bind ADAE rows by ae_types: filter by condition, add AETYPE (= label), then row-bind

bind_by_aetype.Rd

Given a data.frame and one or more ae_type objects, this function filters the data by each ae_type's condition, adds an AETYPE label column, and row-binds the results together.

Usage

bind_by_aetype(data, ae_types, verbose = FALSE)

Arguments

data

A data.frame to be filtered (e.g. ADAE).

ae_types

An ae_type object or a list of ae_type objects. A single ae_type object is automatically wrapped in a list.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, a log message is printed for each ae_type showing the label, id, and number of matched rows. Default is FALSE.

Value

A data.frame with added columns id and AETYPE, row-bound across all ae_types.
